import.intro: Choose the CSV file exported from StoryGraph. It is read on this device and is not sent anywhere. You will see a preview first; notes are created only after you confirm.
import.limits: Limits: a file of up to {size} MB, up to {rows} rows, up to {field} characters in one field.
import.reading: Reading the file and checking the library…
import.safety: Existing notes are never changed or replaced. Notes are created one by one, not all at once: if the import stops or fails, the notes already created stay, and the next import skips them.
import.sync: Only one import runs at a time in this Obsidian window. An import on another device is not visible from here: if the vault is synced, import on one device and let the sync finish before importing elsewhere, or the same book can be created twice.
import.nothing: There is nothing to create: no row of this file needs a new note.
import.busy: Another import is running. Wait until it ends, then confirm.
import.stale: The file, the settings or the library changed after the preview, so nothing was created. This is the new plan: check it and confirm again.
import.checking: Checking the file, the settings and the library…
import.notice: StoryGraph import finished. Notes created: {created} of {total}.
import.result.title: Result of the import of {file}
import.result.error: The import stopped because of an error: {message}
import.result.stopped: You stopped the import before it ended.
import.result.conflicts: Not created, the file name was taken in the meantime: {count}
import.result.partialItem: {name}: an incomplete file was left in the library. Check or delete it by hand. ({message})
import.result.rerun: To create the rest, confirm the import again. The notes that exist are recognised and skipped.
import.warning.sessionStartOmitted: Dates Read “{session}”: the start has no exact day and was left out.
import.warning.sessionReversed: Dates Read “{session}”: the read ends before it starts and was left out.
import.warning.sessionOmitted: Dates Read “{session}”: the finish has no exact day, so this read was left out.
import.warning.lastDateOmitted: Last Date Read “{value}” is not an exact day and was left out.
import.warning.abandonedUnconfirmed: The book is abandoned: the dates in Dates Read that are not confirmed as a finished read were left out.
import.warning.lastDatePredates: Last Date Read ({date}) is earlier than a finish in Dates Read and was left out.
import.warning.lastDateDisagrees: Last Date Read ({date}) does not agree with Dates Read and was left out.
import.warning.readCountInvalid: Read Count “{value}” is not a number.
import.warning.readCountMore: Read Count is {count}, but a confirmed finish date was found for {dated}. Reads without dates were left out.
import.warning.readCountFewer: Read Count is {count}, but {dated} dated reads were found. The dated reads were kept.
import.warning.sameDayFinishes: Several reads ended on the same day. The statistics count that day once.
import.warning.noConfirmedFinish: The book is marked as read, but no finish date is confirmed. It will have no date in the statistics.
import.warning.noSingleStart: Dates Read does not show one clear start of the current read, so no start date was set.
import.warning.pausedAsInProgress: The StoryGraph status “paused” is imported as a book in progress.
import.warning.idUnrecognised: ISBN/UID is not a valid ISBN or ASIN. A repeated import recognises this book only if its row in the file is exactly the same.
import.warning.idMissing: ISBN/UID is empty. A repeated import recognises this book only if its row in the file is exactly the same.
import.warning.ratingOmitted: Star Rating “{value}” was left out: Colophon ratings go in half-star steps.
import.warning.formatOmitted: Format “{value}” was left out: no Colophon format matches it.
import.warning.dateAddedOmitted: Date Added “{value}” is not an exact date and was left out.
import.skip.fieldCount: The row has {fields} fields, but the header has {expected}.
import.skip.fieldTooLong: A field of the row is longer than {limit} characters.
import.skip.noStatus: Read Status “{value}” has no matching Colophon status.
import.skip.ambiguousRows: Several rows of the file have the same identity, so it is not clear which one to import.
import.skip.ambiguousNotes: {count} notes in the library already carry the identity of this row.
import.error.tooLarge: The file is larger than {limit} MB.
import.error.tooManyRows: The file has more than {limit} rows.
import.error.unclosedQuote: The file ends inside a quoted field: a quote is not closed.
import.error.duplicateColumns: The file has two columns with the same name.
import.error.missingColumns: This does not look like a StoryGraph export. Missing columns: {columns}.
import.error.config: Colophon/config.json cannot be read or has problems. Fix it, then choose the file again.
import.error.language: The language “{language}” set in Colophon/config.json has no locale file.
import.error.libraryPath: The library folder “{path}” cannot be used: it is hidden or it is not a folder.
import.error.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may have changed or moved: choose it again. ({message})
import.error.unexpected: The import could not be prepared: {message}
